name: @ifos/granola
description: IFOS Granola MCP wrapper — typed surface over the official Granola MCP server at https://mcp.granola.ai/mcp + OAuth 2.1 PKCE token persistence + per-workspace_id rate-limit + plan-tier guard + typed errors. Used by Scribe agent (W6+) for meeting transcript ingest. Wraps the 6 official Granola MCP tools (query_granola_meetings, list_meetings, get_meetings, list_meeting_folders, get_meeting_transcript, get_account_info) adding IFOS-specific rate-limit, ESC mapping, audit, and PaidPlan-only guards on folders + transcripts.
